note: The Mubasher raw daily panel already appears adjusted for most rights/bonus events (no ex-date drop).  The theoretical TERP factor is applied only when the observed ex-date drop is negative and the residual return after applying the factor is within 5% (geometric test); otherwise the raw series is left unchanged and the event is labelled.  Out-of-the-money rights are capped at 1.0.  Unmatched/incomplete events are not guessed.  This adjusts rights only; cash dividends and bonus/split actions are separate.
